title: The Hollow Machine Revisited
author: Marguerite Brightwater
blurb: Elodie Eastwick, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
